skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply econometric models and methods to analyze economic data and relationships.
Perform statistical analysis and hypothesis testing on economic data.
Analyze and interpret data using econometric software such as R.
Develop research questions, collect data, and apply econometric models to answer research questions.
Evaluate and critique econometric models and research findings.
Communicate research findings effectively through reports and presentations.
Work effectively in teams to conduct research and solve problems.
Apply econometric techniques to solve economic problems.
Manage time effectively to complete research tasks and assignments.
Independently learn and apply new econometric techniques and software.
